# VMS Truck Parts

> VMS Truck Parts is an independent online parts supplier in Melbourne, Victoria that specialises in parts for the MP4 and MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros (OM471 and OM473 engines). Every part is listed by Mercedes-Benz OE number with aftermarket cross-references, the shop checks fitment from your VIN or rego before you pay, and orders ship Australia-wide by Australia Post or can be picked up free in Victoria.

Key facts:
- Website: https://vmstruckparts.com.au/ (online shop, prices in AUD, Stripe checkout with card, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Afterpay)
- Specialty: parts for the Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 and MP5 only (OM471 and OM473 engines)
- Location: Melbourne, Victoria, Australia. Ships Australia-wide by Australia Post; free pickup in Victoria
- Postage: charged at cost. Small parts in satchels from $11.70; bigger parts priced live to the postcode
- Fitment check: text a VIN or rego to 0481 309 893 and the shop confirms the right part before payment
- Returns: unused parts within 30 days
- Contact: 0481 309 893 (call or text), vmstruckparts@gmail.com, Mon to Fri 7am to 6pm, Sat 7am to 12pm
- Independent supplier, not affiliated with Mercedes-Benz or Daimler Truck; OE numbers are for reference

Every part VMS Truck Parts lists, by category. Each line: part name and link, what it suits, Mercedes-Benz OE numbers, aftermarket cross-references, price in AUD, stock.
